label: For "Test Failure Triage and Root Cause Agent": Classify test failures as product bug, test bug, environment or flake and point to the likely cause with log evidence so engineers fix the right thing quickly. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Closing without confirmation.
